title: Floating Shaman in Aurora
description: A woman in a shimmering green and gold patterned bodysuit floats upside down in the center of a surreal cosmic scene, arms outstretched. Below her is a glowing circular pool with waterfalls cascading over rocky cliffs into a dark void filled with glowing particles, ghostly figures, twisted trees, and vibrant aurora borealis lights.
prompt: A woman wearing a tight green and gold patterned bodysuit and a black cap with a white flower floats upside down in the center of a surreal dreamlike scene, arms gracefully outstretched, surrounded by glowing aurora borealis in purple and green, twisted leafless trees, a circular glowing pool with concentric rings below her, waterfalls cascading from rocky cliffs into a dark void filled with ghostly figures, stars, and ethereal light, mystical and cosmic atmosphere.
